title: A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 4, part 2: John Tyler
summary: "A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 4, part 2" compiled by James D. Richardson is a historical collection published in the late nineteenth century. This volume contains the official proclamations, messages, and speeches of President John Tyler during his term from April 1841 to March 1845.
